import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import fdrcorrection

# 1. Load data
mut_df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['Hugo_Symbol', 'patient_id'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Identify TERT-mutant patients
tert_mutants = set(mut_df.loc[mut_df['Hugo_Symbol'] == 'TERT', 'patient_id'])

# 3. Extract TERT expression (handle version suffix)
# Look for ENSG00000164362 in index
terns = [idx for idx in expr.index if idx.startswith('ENSG00000164362')]
if not terns:
    raise ValueError("TERT Ensembl ID not found in expression data")
tert_id = terns[0]
tert_expr = expr.loc[tert_id]

# 4. Map samples to patients and average
patient_ids = tert_expr.index.str[:12]
tert_per_patient = tert_expr.groupby(patient_ids).mean()

# 5. Build status and expression DataFrame
status = tert_per_patient.index.to_series().apply(lambda x: 'Mutant' if x in tert_mutants else 'Wildtype')
df = pd.DataFrame({'TERT_expr': tert_per_patient.values, 'Status': status.values})

# 6. Statistical test
mut_vals = df.loc[df['Status'] == 'Mutant', 'TERT_expr']
wt_vals = df.loc[df['Status'] == 'Wildtype', 'TERT_expr']
U, p_value = mannwhitneyu(mut_vals, wt_vals, alternative='two-sided')
# FDR correction for single test
_, fdr = fdrcorrection([p_value])

# Compute medians
medians = df.groupby('Status')['TERT_expr'].median()

# Prepare results table
results = pd.DataFrame({
    'Group': ['Mutant', 'Wildtype'],
    'Median_TERT_expr': [medians['Mutant'], medians['Wildtype']]  
})
results['U_stat'] = [U, U]
results['p_value'] = [p_value, p_value]
results['FDR'] = [fdr[0], fdr[0]]
print("TERT Expression by Mutation Status:")
print(results.to_string(index=False))

# 7. Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Status', y='TERT_expr', data=df, palette=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
sns.stripplot(x='Status', y='TERT_expr', data=df, color='gray', alpha=0.6, jitter=True)
plt.ylabel('TERT expression (log2 FPKM)')
plt.title('TERT Expression by TERT Mutation Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Higher tumor mutation burden is associated with worse overall survival in melanoma patients.

• Kaplan–Meier plot stratified by TMB group with confidence intervals.
• Interpretation of whether High‐TMB patients have significantly worse overall survival.
